observations.note: The track reaches its highest energy level with double-kick drums, but the impact feels slightly restrained.
The sitar sits clearly above the standard rock beat.
The lead line mildly competes with the denser rhythm guitar frequencies.
The distorted guitars sound somewhat thin and lack authentic bottom-end chunk.
The syncopated guitar chugs are functional but lack true amp realism.
The drum groove is steady but feels highly programmed and rigid.
Fast double bass patterns provide forward momentum despite the mechanical feel.
The sitar phrasing reveals some synthetic, MIDI-like articulation.
Slight low-midrange muddiness occurs when the arrangement gets dense.
The combination of the tanpura drone and distorted guitars successfully establishes the requested fusion atmosphere.

overall_note: The track delivers on the core fusion concept with a functional arrangement. However, the production relies heavily on programmed-sounding drums and somewhat digital guitar tones.
